name: ypad-shared
comment: Self-contained package for code shared between Nuxt and sync-server. Declaring deps here means Bun's standard module resolution from `shared/utils/secrets.ts` finds them in `shared/node_modules/` (parent walk-up). Without this, the sync image — which has no top-level node_modules at /app — fails to import `jsonwebtoken` from secrets.ts at startup. The Nuxt side resolves the same import via /app/node_modules; both work because Bun follows the standard Node algorithm in both directions.
